notes:
Language: choose English, हिन्दी, ಕನ್ನಡ, தமிழ், తెలుగు or മലയാളം in Settings → Language. English stays the default; the app restarts in the language you pick.

Downloads: Excel exports (Tasks, attendance, payroll, cashbook and more) are now saved straight into your phone's Download folder. The message that follows has View — which opens the file, or your Downloads if no app can — and Share.

Payslips: a payslip's figures appear only once you have requested it and HR has released it. A month that is ready shows as “Payslip ready — Request it to see it”.

Cashbook: the CEO and MD now appear with everyone else in the cashbook's people lists, and a new Advances button downloads each person's total advance for any dates — for everyone or only the people you choose.

Also fixed: exporting a chat transcript, and the missing spaces on task cards (“Assigned 28 Sept”).
